author: StewieFG
body:
As stupid it sounds, it would be cool to have a suggestion category where you can post your suggestions.

Well, I was suggestion some stuff but I didn't know where to post that, I did post it in server feedback, but still, a suggestion category would be better and easier to the developers and Ivy to find all the suggestions there.

Opinions? :D
